hallucinations: Apache Kafka Streams described as merging ordered records from multiple partitions/streams by event time — Kafka Streams merges by per-partition offset order, not a general by-event-time k-way merge feature.
rationale: Correct k-way min-heap insight with the same O(N log k) vs O(Nk) and divide-and-conquer points as the reference, but names fewer concrete systems and stretches the Kafka claim.
